scripts.check: next typegen && tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @nodrail/web-shared check && pnpm --filter @nodrail/sdk check && pnpm --filter @nodrail/cli check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @nodrail/agent-plugins build && vitest run --project unit --project components && pnpm --filter @nodrail/sdk test && pnpm --filter @nodrail/cli test
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests e2e-app e2e-selfhosted scripts ../../packages/sdk/src ../../packages/sdk/tests ../../packages/sdk/examples ../../packages/agent-plugins/scripts ../../packages/cli/src ../../packages/cli/tests ../../packages/cli/scripts ../../packages/web-shared *.json *.mjs *.ts
